info.adoration: The Adoration Room is accessible for prayers and adoration after the first Mass of the day until 10pm. It is closed for cleaning every Saturday morning from 9.45am to 11.45am.
info.confession: The Sacrament of Reconciliation is available 30 minutes before Weekend Masses, excluding the Saturday 7.00am Mass.

events.title: Franciscan vision of God, Creation and human fraternity
events.text: Join Fr Nathan at the Parish hall to discover the Franciscan vision of God, Creation and human fraternity.

events.title: Holy Family Spirituality: stillness and movement
events.text: Half-day talk/retreat by Fr Zhang Liyong at Holy Family Church, 4th floor prayer hall. Register with 洪金惠 90918332 or 徐人心 94308817.

events.title: 圣爱相随 walking pilgrimage
events.text: From St Joseph's Church Bukit Timah to Queen of Angels Church and back. Organized by 主徒会. No registration; start on time.

events.title: Marian devotion: 义德之径
events.text: Speaker: Fr Peng Zhishun. Talk, Rosary, Marian devotion at Holy Trinity Church chapel, 20 Tampines Street 11. No registration.

events.title: All Saints celebration
events.text: Dress as your favourite saint at Church of St Bernadette. 4.30pm photo, 6pm Mass, procession of saints, 7pm dinner and fellowship. Registration required for procession and dinner: https://tinyurl.com/stbernsallsaints

events.title: 2026 Chinese retreat
events.text: Theme: Encountering Christ in Creation, one body many members. Speaker: Fr Peter Koh. Talks, group sharing, ends with Mass at St Bernadette Hall. Fee $10 includes lunch and tea. Register with 立斌 91195952 or 永昌 96628873.
